name: Boards
note: The installer (bin/app_install.php, step 'registry') writes mcp/registries/boards.json in the kernel from this file's `resolve` block plus mcp/action_registry.json. Each resolve tool answers a plain LIST of rows carrying id_field and label_field when given `q` alone (docs/boards-mcp-tool-surface.md, 'The resolvers', Phase 1). A board resolves by its title (a template too); an item, a comment, a version and a dispatch are ids only, never resolved by name — an agent finds an item with board_search inside a board it names.
